title: Numerical verification of the refined Mazur-Tate conjecture in ranks 0-3, with an elementary formula for the Mazur-Tate pairing (v0.7)
description:
Code, data, logs and the technical note Numerical verification of the refined Mazur-Tate conjecture in ranks 0-3, with an elementary formula for the Mazur-Tate pairing (version 0.7, note revision 161).

Status: unreviewed numerical note. Nothing here proves or claims progress on the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture. The results are numerical checks of an existing conjecture.

Contents: (i) a verification of the leading-term identity of the refined Mazur-Tate conjecture at about 1700 non-trivial prime levels on 33 elliptic curves of ranks 0 to 3, with no failures, including an independent re-implementation and a blind test (237 levels, constant predicted in advance); (ii) a closed coordinate formula for the Mazur-Tate pairing, <R,R> = [A(R)]^(-1), without an auxiliary point, derived from the biextension definition and agreeing up to sign with the auxiliary-point formula of Mazur-Tate (1987, p. 747) used by Portillo-Bobadilla (2019, eq. (18)), with the integrality step proved for every prime (the only remaining hypothesis is the identification of the local splittings with those of Mazur-Tate 1983); (iii) exploratory results: a test of the Sha factor in rank 2, a two-legged Kolyvagin class in rank 3 predicted before computation, and statistics of the pairing matrix mod p on 15,034 curves with a registered 3-isogeny effect.

Correction in v0.7. Version 0.6 stated that we had not found the pairing formula in print. That was wrong: a formula with an auxiliary point goes back to Mazur-Tate (1987) and was used numerically by Portillo-Bobadilla (2019). Version 0.7 credits both; the earlier record is kept unchanged.

How the work was done. The author is not a professional mathematician. The computations and the drafting were carried out with an AI system (Claude, by Anthropic) in separate sessions; every numerical claim was checked by running code, and errors found along the way are recorded rather than removed. See REPRODUCAO.md for the full reproduction log.

Website for a general audience (Portuguese and English): https://raufalencar.github.io/mazur-tate-rank2-numerics/
